New in Anchore Enterprise v6.2: native AI model detection. 

Container scanners built for Python, Java, and C++ don't handle multi-gigabyte model weights well. This release adds native inspection for GGUF files and Docker Models, indexing them as packages in your SBOM catalog alongside your open source dependencies.

https://anchore.com/blog/extending-supply-chain-security-to-ai-models-with-anchore-enterprise-v6-2/
